title: Cherry Chocolate Chip Granola
changes_from_base: Pressed into a firm, even sheet with a metal spatula and baked unstirred so it sets into big chunks, using oil, maple syrup and brown sugar, with almonds; chopped dried cherries and mini chocolate chips replace the raisins after cooling.
summary: An almond-based granola studded with tart dried cherries and sweet chocolate chips, creating a perfect balance of flavours and textures.
equipment: large rimmed baking tray (about 33 x 46 cm)

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Preheat
steps.text: Set the oven to 165 °C (145 °C fan) with the shelf in the upper-middle and line a large rimmed baking tray with baking paper.

steps.title: Whisk
steps.text: Whisk together 120 ml vegetable oil, 80 ml maple syrup, 66 g light brown sugar, 4 tsp vanilla and ½ tsp fine salt in a large bowl.

steps.title: Fold
steps.text: Fold through 425 g rolled oats and 285 g raw almonds roughly chopped until everything is evenly coated.

steps.title: Spread
steps.text: Tip the mixture onto the lined tray, spread thinly and press down very firmly with a stiff metal spatula to create a compact, even sheet.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake for 40-45 min, rotating the tray halfway, until light golden.

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: Remove and cool on a wire rack for 1 h, then break into pieces of whatever size you prefer.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Once completely cold, stir in 285 g dried cherries chopped and 170 g mini semi-sweet chocolate chips.

tips: Toast and cool the granola fully before adding chocolate chips to prevent them from melting
Chop the dried cherries into bite-sized pieces so they distribute evenly throughout
Break the cooled granola gently so you get a mix of clusters and individual pieces
storage: Store in an airtight container for up to 2 weeks. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
